claim: Neural links augment or bypass specialized brain functions.
originalWording: Neural links augment or bypass specialized brain functions.

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: Computers and communications in 2029: neural pathways

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: High-bandwidth neural links materially replace or augment specialized brain-region functions.
reference.rationale: The 2029 deadline is future. Clinical sensory implants and neural-interface research support partial progress, not the broadly perfected high-bandwidth cognitive bypass described.
